boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-Sacramento
boards.description: A practical set of currently documented late-hour food stops on or near the Sacramento State area, with drive-thru or dine-in details stated conservatively.

cards.title: Denny's on College Town Drive
cards.subtitle: 7900 College Town Dr., Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: Use the all-hours listing for a meal when other kitchens have closed; check the location page before leaving for service changes.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour, full-service option in the College Town area.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its restaurant at 7900 College Town Dr. as open 24 hours and identifies walk-ins, takeout, lunch, dinner, and round-the-clock breakfast service.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day; walk-ins are welcome.

cards.title: The Melt on Fair Oaks Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2070 Fair Oaks Blvd., Ste. 160, Sacramento, CA 95825
cards.notes: Plan a pickup, dine-in, or delivery meal from this Fair Oaks Boulevard location; confirm the posted day’s hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A late-night burger and grilled-cheese destination listed less than a mile from Sac State.
cards.evidence_claim: The Melt's location page places this restaurant less than one mile from Sacramento State University and says it is open until midnight every day.
cards.source_title: The Melt — 2070 Fair Oaks Blvd., Sacramento
cards.access_notes: The official FAQ says this location is open until midnight every day; it offers pickup, dine-in, and delivery.

cards.title: Chick-N-Guys on Power Inn Road
cards.subtitle: 3311 Power Inn Rd., Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: For a late meal, use the restaurant’s online ordering or visit during its listed Monday–Saturday midnight closing window.
cards.short_summary: A Power Inn Road chicken restaurant with documented midnight service most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-N-Guys lists its Sacramento address and hours of 11 a.m.–midnight Monday through Saturday, with Sunday hours ending at 8 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list Monday–Saturday 11:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. and Sunday 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: NY Gyros & Philly's — La Riviera Drive
cards.title: NY Gyros & Philly's on La Riviera
cards.subtitle: 7670 La Riviera Dr., Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: Choose this La Riviera location for a late pickup order and use the weekday or weekend closing time shown on its official locations page.
cards.short_summary: A La Riviera food stop with midnight hours most nights and a later weekend close.
cards.evidence_claim: NY Gyros & Philly's lists its La Riviera Drive location open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours for 7670 La Riviera Dr.: 10 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday; 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 8750 La Riviera Dr.
cards.title: Jack in the Box on La Riviera Drive
cards.subtitle: 8750 La Riviera Dr., Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when arriving after the lobby closes; verify the day-specific closing time on the official location page.
cards.short_summary: A La Riviera drive-thru with late-night hours documented through the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 8750 La Riviera Dr. drive-thru open until 2 a.m. most days and until 2:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 8750 La Riviera Dr.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours end at 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the lobby closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on La Riviera Drive
cards.subtitle: 7590 La Riviera Drive, Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: For a late food run, follow the location’s drive-thru schedule rather than its earlier dine-in closing time.
cards.short_summary: A La Riviera drive-thru that runs past midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 7590 La Riviera Drive drive-thru open until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists drive-thru hours through 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in ends earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Folsom Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 5625 Folsom Blvd., Sacramento, CA 95819
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru schedule for a Folsom Boulevard option after evening dining rooms close, and check the posted hours first.
cards.short_summary: A Folsom Boulevard late drive-thru with 3–4 a.m. closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 5625 Folsom Blvd. drive-thru open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists drive-thru hours to 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in ends earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Howe Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1300 Howe Ave., Sacramento, CA 95825
cards.notes: Make this a drive-thru stop after an evening on Howe Avenue; the official page separates its late drive-thru hours from dine-in service.
cards.short_summary: A Howe Avenue location with drive-thru service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 1300 Howe Ave. drive-thru open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours run to 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Marconi Avenue
cards.subtitle: 4318 Marconi Ave., Sacramento, CA 95821
cards.notes: Rely on the drive-thru if you arrive later in the evening, since the official listing shows different hours for the dining room.
cards.short_summary: A Marconi Avenue drive-thru option with service until 3 or 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 4318 Marconi Ave. drive-thru open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists drive-thru hours to 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in ends earlier.

cards.title: Carl's Jr. on Folsom Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 8397 Folsom Blvd., Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: Use this Folsom Boulevard location for an evening meal and confirm the specific day’s closing time before you travel.
cards.short_summary: A Sacramento 95826 fast-food stop officially listed as closing at midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl's Jr. lists its restaurant at 8397 Folsom Blvd., Sacramento, CA 95826, as closing at midnight.
cards.access_notes: The official Carl's Jr. location page states that this restaurant closes at midnight.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Sacramento State spaces for studying, meeting, recreation, making, and taking a quiet break between classes.

cards.title: University Library
cards.subtitle: Library building
cards.notes: Use the library as a planned study stop: bring a task list, then ask at a service desk when you need help locating research support.
cards.short_summary: A central academic building with research and student-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State identifies the University Library as a campus landmark and lists it among academic buildings operating 8 a.m.–10 p.m. in its campus addendum.
cards.source_title: Campus Addendum to the Interim CSU Systemwide Time, Place and Manner Policy
cards.access_notes: Campus policy lists academic-building operating hours; confirm library service hours before a visit.

cards.title: StingerStudio Makerspace
cards.subtitle: University Library, Room 1529
cards.notes: Plan a making session around a project need, and check in with library staff for current equipment access or scheduled workshops.
cards.short_summary: A library makerspace for hands-on creative and project work.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State lists StingerStudio Makerspace in Library Room 1529, next to the Carlsen Center.
cards.access_notes: The university page lists weekday service hours; verify availability and any equipment requirements before going.

cards.title: Student Research Center
cards.subtitle: University Library, Room 2026
cards.notes: Bring a draft question, outline, or citation problem so a research-support visit can focus quickly on the next step in your project.
cards.short_summary: A named library location for student research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State lists the Student Research Center in Library Room 2026 and publishes its weekday hours.
cards.access_notes: University-listed hours vary by day; check the current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Peer and Academic Resource Center
cards.subtitle: University Library, Room 4026
cards.notes: Use this stop to plan tutoring or peer academic support; arrive with the course, assignment, and a specific question ready to discuss.
cards.short_summary: A library-based peer academic-support location.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State lists the Peer and Academic Resource Center (PARC) in Library Room 4026 and publishes weekday hours.
cards.access_notes: Check the published weekday schedule and any appointment or drop-in details before arrival.

cards.title: Academic Information Resource Center
cards.subtitle: AIRC
cards.notes: Choose the AIRC when you need a long study window, then keep your campus ID and course materials handy for building access.
cards.short_summary: An academic building with extended student study access during fall and spring.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State states that the Academic Information Resource Center is open 24 hours daily for student and staff study during fall and spring semesters.
cards.source_title: Campus Addendum to the Interim CSU Systemwide Time, Place and Manner Policy
cards.access_notes: The 24-hour study access is specified for fall and spring semesters; access may differ at other times.

cards.title: University Union
cards.subtitle: Campus gathering and services building
cards.notes: Use the Union as a practical meet-up point before an event or student-organization meeting, and consult the information desk for wayfinding.
cards.short_summary: A campus-life building with programs, services, and shared gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State says the University Union and The WELL provide environments where students and others participate in campus life.
cards.access_notes: The campus addendum classifies the Union as limited-access space and publishes operating hours; reservations may be required for activities.

cards.title: Games Room
cards.subtitle: University Union, first floor
cards.notes: Build in a short recreational break between classes, and check the Union’s current desk information for activity availability that day.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor University Union recreation space.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State lists the Games Room on the first floor of the University Union and publishes weekday hours.
cards.access_notes: The university page lists Monday–Friday hours; verify current operations before visiting.

cards.title: University Union Gallery
cards.subtitle: University Union, second floor
cards.notes: Check the gallery’s current exhibition before heading upstairs, then allow time to view the work at a comfortable, unhurried pace.
cards.short_summary: A named second-floor gallery space in the University Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State identifies the University Union Gallery as being on the second floor of the University Union.
cards.access_notes: Hours and exhibitions can change; confirm the current gallery schedule before visiting.

cards.title: The WELL
cards.subtitle: Student recreation and wellness facility
cards.notes: Plan a recreation or wellness visit around your schedule, and review current facility guidance before using activity areas or services.
cards.short_summary: A campus facility supporting recreation, wellness, and participation in campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State says The WELL’s programs, services, and facilities foster personal growth, healthy decision-making, and social interaction.
cards.access_notes: The campus addendum lists facility operating hours and notes that reservations may be required for activities.

cards.title: Library Quad
cards.subtitle: Outdoor lawn by the Library
cards.notes: Use this outdoor landmark for a daylight reset or a planned group meet-up, while keeping paths clear and respecting any reserved activity.
cards.short_summary: A named campus lawn space beside the library area.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State identifies Library Quad as an outdoor lawn space and names it in campus policy for permitted outdoor activity.
cards.source_title: Campus Addendum to the Interim CSU Systemwide Time, Place and Manner Policy
cards.access_notes: Campus policy lists this as public outdoor lawn space during stated hours; events or other uses may require reservation.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified Sacramento State activities with no admission charge or purchase required.

cards.title: Browse the Robert Else Gallery
cards.subtitle: Kadema Hall, Sacramento State
cards.notes: Walk through a current Art Department exhibition in Kadema Hall, then use the displayed work as an easy conversation starter.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery stop for viewing student, faculty, or visiting-artist work.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State says Art Department events, including art exhibitions, are free and open to the public; the Robert Else Gallery is in Kadema Hall.
cards.access_notes: Check the Art Department's event listings for the current exhibition schedule.

cards.title: See what's installed at the Witt Gallery
cards.subtitle: Kadema Hall, Sacramento State
cards.notes: Visit the R.W. & Joyce Witt Gallery with a friend and take time to look at how the exhibition is arranged.
cards.short_summary: A named Kadema Hall gallery used for Sacramento State art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State identifies the R.W. & Joyce Witt Gallery in Kadema Hall and states admission to Art Department-sponsored events is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Exhibition timing varies; consult the Art Department listing before heading over.

cards.title: Look through a University Union Gallery show
cards.subtitle: University Union, Sacramento State
cards.notes: Pair a gallery visit with time in the Union and compare one piece each that caught your attention.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus gallery connected with student and faculty exhibition activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State says students and faculty are frequently involved in University Union Gallery exhibitions, and that admission to Art Department-sponsored events is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Check whether a show is currently on view before visiting.

cards.title: Take in a Library Gallery exhibition
cards.subtitle: University Library, Sacramento State
cards.notes: Stop by the University Library Gallery to view the current display, then explore related library resources together.
cards.short_summary: A library-based exhibition space connected with Sacramento State art activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State says students and faculty are frequently involved in University Library Gallery exhibitions, and that admission to Art Department-sponsored events is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Verify the current display and library access information before going.

cards.title: Attend a visiting scholar lecture
cards.subtitle: Sacramento State Art Department
cards.notes: Choose a scheduled visiting scholar talk, arrive a few minutes early, and stay afterward to discuss the speaker's ideas.
cards.short_summary: A free campus talk series connected to the Art Department.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State lists visiting scholar lectures among its free public Art Department events and says admission to sponsored events is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Dates and locations depend on the current Art Department calendar.

cards.title: Visit the Annual Student Awards Show
cards.subtitle: Sacramento State Art Department
cards.notes: Plan around the annual show to see student work together and read the accompanying exhibition labels at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Art Department showcase of student work.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State names the Annual Student Awards Show among its free public Art Department events and says admission to sponsored events is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the annual show's dates and venue through the Art Department.

cards.title: Drop into the Art History Symposium
cards.subtitle: Sacramento State Art Department
cards.notes: Attend a symposium session with a classmate and jot down one question or idea to unpack after the program.
cards.short_summary: A free Art Department academic gathering focused on art history.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State includes the Art History Symposium among its free public Art Department events and says admission to sponsored events is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Look for the current symposium schedule and location from the Art Department.

cards.title: Join the end-of-year Art Ball
cards.subtitle: Sacramento State Art Department
cards.notes: Check the Art Department's end-of-year schedule, bring friends, and take part in the event's arts-focused campus gathering.
cards.short_summary: A named end-of-year Art Department event.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State lists the end-of-year Art Ball among its free public Art Department events and says admission to sponsored events is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current year's date, venue, and program with the Art Department.

cards.title: Kick off fall at Hornet Nest Fest
cards.subtitle: Main Quad, Sacramento State
cards.notes: Register for the fall welcome celebration, meet campus groups, play games, and spend time in the music and creative activity zones.
cards.short_summary: Sacramento State's official fall welcome celebration for enrolled students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State states that Hornet Nest Fest is free for Fall 2026 enrolled students and includes activities, entertainment, music, dancing, and games.
cards.access_notes: For Fall 2026 enrolled students; scheduled August 28, 2026, 6–9 p.m., with registration requested.

cards.entity_name: Lantern Festival & Pop-Up Market: Illuminate the Hive
cards.title: Make plans for the Lantern Festival
cards.subtitle: Sacramento State
cards.notes: RSVP for this campus cultural gathering, explore the pop-up market, and use the event as a low-pressure way to meet people.
cards.short_summary: A Sacramento State AANHPI community celebration with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State states that admission to its Lantern Festival & Pop-Up Market is completely free and that it is open to students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Lantern Festival & Pop-Up Market: Illuminate the Hive
cards.access_notes: Open to Sacramento State students, faculty, and staff; RSVP is encouraged. Campus parking may carry standard fees.
